free_tier.stated: Bifrost is a peer-to-peer communications engine with pluggable transports. It supports dynamic configuration of transports, listeners, forwarding rules, and can tunnel other protocols over WebRTC and Quic. Apache 2.0 License. Written in Go.

egress.terms: No hosted allowance exists: the software runs on a host that is supplied separately.; ingress: tcp+udp

record.binding_note: software only: no hosted endpoint is offered, so any egress it provides begins with a host that a user must get from a compute provider. P2P engine tunnelling over WebRTC and QUIC.
